# SC-01: The Monday sales report counts every sale once

## Steps
1. Put one of the two past weekly till exports in the test folder copy before 7:00 on Monday.
2. At 8:00, open the sales report and count the sales by hand.

## Expected result
The report is ready by 8:00 with every sale counted once; both reports match a hand count (2 cases).

## Data (by pointer only)
Source: 2 weekly till exports the shop sends (real data: client decision, shop manager, 2026-11-10); records: the two past weeks the shop manager picks; count: 2; fields: title, quantity.
